# Load data and model sims
```{r}
infant_data = read_csv(here('infants/data/infant_exposure_duration.csv')) %>% filter(fam_or_test == 'test', !exclude)
infant_data = infant_data %>% mutate(subj_id = paste0(experiment, subject_num))

# load data
aligned_data = read_csv(here('simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_aligned_eig.csv')) 
resnet50_data = read_csv(here('simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_eig.csv')) 
KL_data = read_csv(here('simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_KL.csv'))
surprisal_data_short = read_csv(here('simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_surprisal_short.csv'))
surprisal_data_long = read_csv(here('simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_surprisal_long.csv'))
nonoise_data = read_csv(here('simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_nonoise.csv'))
nolearning_data = read_csv(here('simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_nolearning.csv'))


# remove the trial 0 of novel and some renaming
aligned_data = aligned_data %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()
resnet50_data = resnet50_data %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()
KL_data = KL_data %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()
surprisal_data_short = surprisal_data_short %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()
surprisal_data_long = surprisal_data_long %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()
nonoise_data = nonoise_data %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()
nolearning_data = nolearning_data %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()

```


# Split half cross-validation
```{r}

# run splithalf n times for each sim
num_splithalfs = 100

aligned_EIG_df = repeat_splithalf(aligned_data, infant_data, num_splithalfs) 
resnet50_EIG_df = repeat_splithalf(resnet50_data, infant_data, num_splithalfs) 
resnet50_KL_df = repeat_splithalf(KL_data, infant_data, num_splithalfs)
resnet50_surprisal_short_df = repeat_splithalf(surprisal_data_short, infant_data, num_splithalfs)
resnet50_surprisal_long_df = repeat_splithalf(surprisal_data_long, infant_data, num_splithalfs)
resnet50_nonoise_df <- repeat_splithalf(nonoise_data, infant_data, num_splithalfs)
resnet50_nolearning_df <- repeat_splithalf(nolearning_data, infant_data, num_splithalfs)

# linear model 
linmodel_df = list()

for (x in 1:num_splithalfs){
    linmodel_df[[x]] <- run_splithalf_linmodel(infant_data)
}


saveRDS(aligned_EIG_df, here("cached_data/infant_splithalf_aligned_eig.Rds"))
saveRDS(resnet50_EIG_df, here("cached_data/infant_splithalf_resnet50_eig.Rds"))
saveRDS(resnet50_KL_df, here("cached_data/infant_splithalf_resnet50_KL.Rds"))
saveRDS(resnet50_surprisal_short_df, here("cached_data/infant_splithalf_resnet50_surprisal_short.Rds"))
saveRDS(resnet50_surprisal_long_df, here("cached_data/infant_splithalf_resnet50_surprisal_long.Rds"))
saveRDS(resnet50_nonoise_df, here("cached_data/infant_splithalf_resnet50_nonoise.Rds"))
saveRDS(resnet50_nolearning_df, here("cached_data/infant_splithalf_resnet50_nolearning.Rds"))
saveRDS(linmodel_df %>% bind_rows(), here("cached_data/infant_splithalf_linmodel.Rds"))

```
